title: "Usa questa": an image sent in chat becomes the candidate
goal: The owner can attach the photo just sent to the item found
acceptance: Owner idea 2026-11-26 in chat: "in future I will be able to recover a recipe or a hobo place, say it was without image, I will be able to put it in chat and tell to use that, or to find some on the web, propose (using genUI?) and save the accepted." Italian is required for every model-facing feature.

After F-143-T03 finds the item, an image the owner sends in the same Telegram conversation (the existing photo intake in src/telegram.ts and src/photos.ts limits) becomes the single candidate in the image-choice surface; "usa questa" / "use this one" works in Italian and English

No vision: NERV does not read or describe the image, it stores the sent image with the item (a recipe's photos; a place through hobo:F-018) after the owner's approval; owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "undo the F-143 dependency" on F-142
privacy: Invented recipes, places and images only; web images are fetched only through NERV's egress proxy, the full image only after the owner accepts it; no secrets or API keys in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: reuses the existing photo intake and storage, no vision (unchanged, F-142 dependency removed). Not a measurement.
